# Gallag Works

> Founder-led AI transformation that eliminates the Human Middleware — manual re-keying, spreadsheet workarounds, and coordination overhead that erode enterprise margins.

Gallag Works is the independent practice of Ben Gallagher, with 15+ years directing enterprise delivery for Tier-1 retailers and FTSE 100 entities. The practice diagnoses operational friction, re-engineers workflows, and embeds AI-enabled systems — measured by capacity reclaimed and margin recovered.
